_doc: Recipe per transformers model_type: LoRA target modules and the precision of the paper recipe. `fp16_amp` = fp32 weights with fp16 autocast (torch_dtype float32); `bf16` = bf16 weights with bf16 autocast. `attn_implementation` is the attention of the training forward under mixed precision (flash kernels need fp16 / bf16); selection uses `selection_attn_implementation`, `selection_prefix_dtype`, `selection_prefix_fp32_tail` (trailing prefix blocks kept in fp32 under a float16 prefix), and `train_fp32_tail` (trailing blocks whose q/k projections and attention run in fp32 in the mixed-precision TRAINING forward), and `pack_tokens`. The Phi-2 fp16 selection prefix with a 2-block fp32 tail, the 3-block fp32 training tail and 1536-token selection packs are measured optimizations, not the upstream recipe. Model types that are not listed use `default`.
